notes: Values for 2026 are IMF estimates from the World Economic Outlook (October 2026).
Debt in US$ = gross debt (% of GDP) × GDP at current prices (US$), both from the WEO.
Debt in € converts the US$ amount at Eurostat's annual average USD/EUR rate (ert_bil_eur_a); years after 2025 use the 2025 rate.
